title: lithocarpus caudatifolius
intro: Lithocarpus caudatifolius, commonly known as Caudatifolius, is a species of flowering plant in the beech family, Fagaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus caudatifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its bioactive compounds have potential therapeutic applications in the treatment of oxidative stress-related diseases.
